parent_hold.reason: Static hold: allowedKeys.contains(null) can throw for valid null-free immutable sets; it also rejects null set elements although the prompt only prohibits null arguments. No new execution.

records.rationale: Original remains held. The prompt forbids null arguments, not null set members. Eliminate allowedKeys.contains(null), which rejects Set.of/TreeSet and introduces an extra member prohibition. decode('a=1;ignored=x;a=2',Set.of('a')) must return only a=2; TreeSet containing a is another ordinary accepted implementation, and HashSet containing null and a must also return a=2. Remove the original unsupported null-member rejection oracle. Preserve field trimming, exactly-one-equals grammar, empty-key rejection, ignored disallowed keys, duplicate-last stable LinkedHashMap order and null-argument rejection. Fresh known-bad restores the unsafe null-member check while retaining the old ignore-unknown correction. Preserve all behavioral prose, replacing only embedded source and neutral diagnosis.
